items: Storm severity is a scenario input; no weather data was provided.
Risk model trained on the February 2025 storm and tested on September 2024.
Repair hours come from the AEP labor workbook; travel/setup multiplier 4.5.
Repair hours for re-stringing a wire span are approximate (not in the workbook).
Damage quantity (Media field) interpreted as count; zeros treated as 1.
Alert rules are challenge assumptions, not AEP policy.
Historical repair dates are day-level only and used as a sanity check.
Your location and any needs you share are used only for this session.
source: Hand-made sample for UI development. Not model output.
